lines.text: Did you know? Flect is Latin for bend.
Quick quiz! Which means back plus bend?

words.ex: The lake reflected the mountains like a mirror.

publish.title: Flect root: reflect, flexible and reflex
publish.value: Flect comes from Latin "flectere" (to bend). Words: reflect, flexible and reflex. reflect = re + flect; reflex = re + flex.
